D.comparison: baseline single Sonnet 4.5 judge with canonical rubric

O.outcome_detail: capture of deliberately unambiguous synthetic egregious failures

result.effect: 100% capture after calibration for all 21 evaluators; before-calibration median 100%, range 73.3–100%; improved on 8 of 21 evaluators

cells.quote: All 21 evaluators reached 100% egregious-case capture after calibration (Figure 3), up from a per-evaluator median of 100% (range 73.3–100%) before calibration.
cells.note: EGR is capture on a deliberately severe, fully synthetic set, not recall over all production failures; per-evaluator denominators ranged from 12 to 79.

cells.quote: A cluster-robust Egger-type precision test did not provide statistically detectable evidence of small-study effects, b = 1.39, SE = 1.34, t(9.79) = 1.03, p =.327.
cells.note: This result sentence is absent from the supplied study-text excerpt; the quote is copied from the wiki entry. The non-significant test is coded ns, not 0, because no equivalence test or adequate-power claim is reported.
